text: “It’s Prince Michael all right.” “Oh!” Anthony was deeply chagrined. “And Mademoiselle has the migraine,” he added aloud, in a dissatisfied tone. “What has that got to do with it?” “Probably nothing, but I wanted to see her. You see, I’ve found out that Mademoiselle has the second room from the end—the one where I saw the light last night.” “That’s interesting.” “Probably there’s nothing in it. All the same, I mean to see Mademoiselle before the day is out.” Lunch was somewhat of an ordeal.
